newsitem.title: GREECE: ING Barings bullish on Greek equities.
newsitem.headline: ING Barings bullish on Greek equities.

text.p: The Athens bourse rally is just the beginning of a longer-term climb but investors should pick quality stocks with high earnings growth rather than laggards, said ING Barings in a flash report on Wednesday.

"If this is the beginning of a longer term rally, as we believe it is, then investors should focus more on quality and earnings growth and less on which stocks have been left behind," said ING Barings.
